notes.title: Update 5 - 05.06.2025
notes.content:
[b]Hello Tactics Fans![/b]

Today, you will receive [b]Update 5[/b]! Once again, new content primarily for the single-player mode is making its way into the game: [i]personnel[/i].

Clubs now have various employees based on the expansion level of their respective buildings. Each employee has an impact on different areas. The effects of assistant coaches, goalkeeper coaches, and youth coaches on training are already implemented. Better employees also mean better effects. For some employees or better employees, certain infrastructure requirements must be met. You can find more information about this in the tutorial.
As with infrastructure, there are monthly running costs (salaries) for each employee. The higher the knowledge level, the higher the monthly costs. Employees can also be dismissed to save costs in financial difficulties. In this case, severance pay will be required. To always keep track of your income and expenses, the Finance tab in the Club menu offers a kind of bank statement.

[u][b]Important:[/b][i] Existing save games can be continued.[/i][/u]

You can find all the changes in the changelog below.

If you encounter any issues, feel free to report them as usual on our Discord server, via email to support@tactics-unlimited.com, or in the Steam discussions.

We hope you enjoy this update!

[b]Your Tactics Unlimited Team[/b]

notes.title: Update 4 - 15.05.2025
notes.content:
[b]Hello Tactics Fans![/b]

Today you’ll receive [b]Update 3[/b]! In addition to minor bug fixes, the main focus is on new single-player content: [i]Infrastructure[/i]. 
Clubs now have various buildings with different upgrade levels. Each building impacts different areas of the game. The effects of the training facilities and the youth academy on training have already been implemented. With each upgrade, the potential impact of a building increases. You can find more information about this in the tutorial.

But be careful: in addition to one-time construction costs, each building incurs monthly maintenance costs. The higher the upgrade level, the higher the monthly expenses. Buildings can also be temporarily deactivated to save costs in financial emergencies. However, since layoffs or bankruptcy are not yet implemented, there's nothing to worry about – for now. 😉
To help you keep track of your income and expenses, the Finances tab in the Club menu offers an account statement-style overview.

[u][b]Important:[/b][i] Existing save games can be continued.[/i][/u]

You can find all the changes in the changelog below.

If you encounter any issues, feel free to report them as usual on our Discord server, via email to support@tactics-unlimited.com, or in the Steam discussions.

We hope you enjoy this update!

[b]Your Tactics Unlimited Team[/b]

notes.title: Update 3 - 24.04.2025
notes.content:
[b]Hello Tactics Fans![/b]

Today you’ll receive [b]Update 3[/b]! This update not only fixes minor bugs and improves player and youth training, but also introduces the first new features for the single-player mode. The main theme is [b]Sponsorships[/b], which help generate income for upcoming content such as ongoing and one-time costs related to infrastructure, staff, player contracts, transfers, and scouting.

You’ll find the sponsorship section in the club menu. [i][b]Please note:[/b][/i] the agency feature is [i][u]not yet included in this update[/u][/i]. More info on this can be found in the tutorial under "General".

[u][b]Important:[/b][i] Existing save games will still work. However, to ensure that all clubs use the correct stadium sizes and therefore the correct number of available advertising boards, a new save game must be started.[/i][/u]

You can find all the changes in the changelog below.

notes.title: Update 1 - 03.04.2025
notes.content:
[i][b]Hello Tactics Fans![/b][/i]

Today, you're getting [b]Update 1[/b]! We've fixed all the bugs you've reported so far and added a brand-new database with updated clubs, rosters, and various other adjustments. The match AI has also been improved and expanded. But that's not all - check out the full changelog below for more details!

[i][u][b]Important:[/b][/u] Due to the new database, all previous save files will become incompatible and will be automatically deleted upon launching the game. In the future, we will do our best to preserve your save data across updates.[/i]

If you encounter any issues, please report them as before on our Discord server, via email at support@tactics-unlimited.com or in the Steam discussions.

We hope you enjoy this update!

[b]Your Tactics Unlimited Team[/b]

- minor localization adjustments
- minor visual adjustments in screens

- first balancing of the AI difficulty
- old savegame are deleted as they become unusable
- club selection screen extended by league selection
- singleplayer: opponents during the season now from the same league
- multiplayer: improved matchmaking for opponents of similar strength

[b]New[/b]
- new database with updated clubs, squads and other adjustments
- match summary now contains correct values
- AI teams now act correctly during corners & free kicks
- AI teams now also move players for corners and free kicks
- AI teams now also use the cross action
- multiplayer: "Play Now" function activated in the lobby

[b]Bugfix[/b]
- fixed an issue where the AI move could not be completed, preventing the match from ending
- played matches are now saved correctly
- color sliders in the jersey editor now respond as expected
- color for jersey sponsor is now applied correctly
- numeric keypad inputs are now working correctly again
- music volume is now saved correctly
- assigned training goals are now displayed correctly
- assigned training goals are no longer incorrectly overwritten
- all skills are now displayed correctly in the training popup
- no more opponents with too few players in the team
- tactics screen now always shows the player's team
- fixed a rare bug where friendly matches led to broken savegames

notes.title: Tactics Unlimited is live! 🚀🎉
notes.content:
Tactics Unlimited is live! 🚀🎉

The wait is over – Tactics Unlimited is now available! Put your strategic skills to the test and compete in exciting multiplayer matches or improve your team in single-player mode across multiple seasons.

🔥 Play now & grow with the community! 🔥
Challenge random opponents or friends, experiment with new tactics, improve your squad, and prove who the true tactics master is!

💬 Your feedback matters!
We want to develop Tactics Unlimited together with you! Join the discussion on Discord and share your ideas:
🔹 What features would you like to see in multiplayer?
🔹 Which new action cards would you love to have?
🔹 What improvements does the match system need?

👀 Sneak peek at Update 1 – coming next week:

Multiplayer: Quick matches with random opponent matchmaking

Updated database with new teams & squads

Improved match AI for even smarter opponents

Bug fixes & optimizations

We’re excited to hear your thoughts – let’s make Tactics Unlimited even better together!

🎮 Jump in & be part of it now!

Your Tactics Unlimited Team
